Asset: narrative event CG, Final Broadcast / 最终广播.
Create a candid photographic 35 mm film still, 16:9, native 2048x1152 requested and at least 1600x900. Natural exposure, soft optical detail, normal contrast and believable depth of field. Human feeling and a small action are the subject.

Before the choice: a soothing state broadcast offers painless sleep and comforting memories if a dissident surrenders two independent channels. She can send her real irregular heartbeat back, or pretend to connect while hiding her waking ember. Show the instant while she is still listening and has chosen neither response.

A tired woman in her forties, wearing a faded blue everyday work jacket, sits sideways in a narrow improvised signal room. The promise of rest has briefly softened her face, but her eyes remain wary. One hand presses a palm-sized shielded amber heartbeat carrier protectively near her collarbone. The other holds a practical transmitter near shoulder height, thumb hovering over its physical send switch without pressing. A small wall receiver beside her has two separate unconnected channel leads hanging from it; these are quiet clues to the cost of accepting. She looks toward the receiver as though listening to a voice that knows exactly what she wants to hear. No other person is visible, no victory or completed transmission.

The room is ordinary and inhabited: chipped pale paint, a padded chair, a modest receiver, a tangled repaired cable and a blurred cup in the background. Soft late-afternoon window light mixed with an ordinary lamp, gentle warm-gray colors and faded blue fabric, natural skin with modest imperfections. Subtle grain, restrained amber device light, no holograms. This should look like a thoughtful candid drama scene photographed in a near-future room, not a glossy game render.

Frame her face, both hands, the carrier and receiver in the left-middle upper 65 percent, all important action above about 60 percent of image height. The person and objects occupy about half the image. Keep the right third quiet with a softly focused plain wall and frosted window. Bottom-left is darker jacket and chair shadow with no essential prop. Continuous room, 35 mm eye-level medium shot, faces and hands naturally in focus.

Avoid: text, letters, digits, readable screens, UI, logos, watermarks, borders, collage; giant architecture, tiny people, posed hero portrait, medieval hood or cloak, fantasy symbols, neon wash, HDR halos, sharpened outlines, perfect plastic skin, oversaturated color, CGI sheen, painterly or illustrated appearance.

assets.briefZh: 依据最终广播的安宁承诺与两个回应选择，呈现疲惫偏频者尚未回应时的倾听。她把火种载体护在胸前，另一只手握着尚未发送的对讲机；墙上两条独立接线提示伪装接入的带宽代价。人物既被安宁吸引又保持警惕，叙事停在选择前。
assets.acceptanceZh: 已通过 view_image 检查：单人自然半身抓拍，脸、双手、火种与接收器清楚，手部和表情无明显异常；日常房间与柔和窗光，正常对比和景深，无巨构主导、HDR 描边、可读文字或水印。右侧磨砂窗安静，左下无关键物件。

An old control-experiment relic lies within the archive. The dissident can keep reading and take it, or dismantle the coercive frequencies page by page. Neither course has been completed.

A middle-aged man with short graying hair and thin practical glasses, wearing a plain tan service jacket over a dark sweater, stands slightly crouched in a narrow maintenance closet. He holds an open physical folio at upper-chest height. One fingertip has stopped halfway through turning a page; a small shielded experimental cartridge is tucked into the open folio's fitted pocket, clearly visible. On the folio's edge is a compact unplugged frequency-decoding tool, ready to detach the coercive signal coupling if chosen. His eyes lift toward a faint scanning line approaching across the wall near the half-open door. Concentration shifts into alert hesitation. No confident triumphant pose, no action already finished.

The setting is human-sized: a moved metal shelf, the revealed service hatch, old binder boxes and a shallow repair cupboard. Page surfaces show only faint abstract technical linework at an angle, absolutely no readable writing or numbers. The tech is modest and believable. A small clipped reading lamp and soft spill from the corridor light his face and paper naturally; faint cool scan light stays in the background. Muted tan, gray and paper cream, honest skin and fabric, slight wear without hyper-detail.

Camera: medium close candid shot from just outside the closet, 50 mm, realistic f/4 focus on face, stopped fingers and the cartridge; gently softer shelving behind. Main face, hands, open folio and experimental part are in the upper and middle left 65 percent, above 60 percent image height. Person and evidence occupy 50 to 65 percent of frame. Right third is a quiet blurred door and plain wall; lower-left is dark jacket and shelf shadow without crucial evidence. One continuous real-looking room.

assets.finalPrompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Narrative event Unstable Lift from Mindrealm Bastion.
An old freight lift has stopped unevenly between two memory-factory levels. A small unregistered relic is caught above the cage roof; the drive coil on the safe maintenance side still stores usable energy. Reaching the relic means crossing an unstable threshold, while dismantling the coil would let the traveler withdraw. Capture the moment she instinctively pauses at that threshold, before choosing.
Use a tense but restrained 35mm medium location-film shot from just inside the cage, looking toward the maintenance landing. A woman worker in her late twenties, with dark hair tied in a practical braid and a worn gray canvas jacket under a faded rust-colored safety harness, braces her body in the misaligned doorway. One hand firmly grips the rail at chest height; her other hand holds her safety tether near her shoulder. Exactly two hands, each clearly attached to its own arm. She has begun to shift her weight back toward safety while looking upward at the trapped relic, with a focused, uneasy expression rather than a heroic pose. No falling, injury or action stunt.
Near her in the upper-left and middle, an open motor housing shows a removable copper drive coil. A small silver optical relic canister is visible on a bracket just above the cage roof, beyond easy reach. The skewed door seam, one slack hanging cable and the firm tether communicate instability. The shaft is only a dim suggestion through the gap, not a panoramic giant void. Worn rubber grips, canvas, plain steel brackets and everyday safety equipment feel real and familiar.
Soft available maintenance light falls across her face and hands, with a little cool daylight leaking from a higher landing. Natural gray, faded rust cloth, dull copper and skin tones; normal contrast, no electrical storm or bright sparks. Keep her face, rail grip, tether hand and the two possible objectives mainly within the left-center 65 percent and in the upper 60 percent of the image. The right third is a quiet defocused cage wall; the bottom-left falls into soft clothing and platform shadow for later text. One person, natural anatomy and a believable moment of waiting or retreat.
Photographic style: a naturally exposed 35mm or 50mm live-action near-future drama still. Soft practical diffuse light, moderate depth of field, normal dynamic range, gentle highlight roll-off, real skin and fabric wear with small imperfections. Let expressions, gestures and story objects carry the scene. Background architecture is supportive and softly rendered. No HDR, over-sharpening, crunchy texture, plastic skin, glossy game-render look, aggressive orange-and-teal grading, poster posing, giant face portraits, illustration, magic, robes or medieval hoods. No readable text, numerals, logos, graphic interface, watermark, border, black bars or collage. Believable hands, anatomy, tools and physical connections. Complete 16:9 landscape, at least 1600x900.
